title: BidAwardEnvelope
description: W3C VerifiablePresentation envelope carrying the Atum award authority's credential, signed over a BidAward and propagated alongside it (published as BidAwardEnvelope.presentation_json, then forwarded to the settler). Mirror of FulfillmentQuoteEnvelope / PaymentRequestEnvelope, with one key difference: the holder is NOT the signer of any inner document — it is the Atum award AUTHORITY (a did:pkh service identity authorized to select/award quotes), and the envelope is bound to a specific award via proof.challenge = award_hash(payment_id, quote_hash, settler_id) (not holder==inner-signer). The settler verifies the holder is a trusted awarder, the embedded quoteAwarder credential + its issuer, and the award_hash binding.

version.description: Semver-shaped declaration version (MAJOR.MINOR). The major component is locked to this schema's parent directory (v1 → major must be 1). Producers MUST emit the canonical value exported by the bindings' Version constant; the canonical bumps on each additive minor evolution.

@context.description: JSON-LD context array. MUST include BOTH the W3C VC v1 context (https://www.w3.org/2018/credentials/v1) and the BidAwardEnvelope v1 context (https://schemas.atum.network/declarations/BidAwardEnvelope/v1/context.jsonld) — without the envelope context, JSON-LD expansion drops envelope-specific terms (challenge, domain, holder) during URDNA2015 canonicalization, so the replay-binding fields end up outside the signed n-quad graph.

type.description: MUST contain 'VerifiablePresentation' per W3C VC Data Model v1.1. Producers also append 'BidAwardEnvelope' (the declaration type) so the envelope KIND is bound into the holder signature as an rdf:type n-quad — the verifier asserts it via ExpectedDeclarationType to reject a relabeled FulfillmentQuoteEnvelope / PaymentRequestEnvelope.

holder.description: did:pkh URI of the Atum award AUTHORITY presenting the quoteAwarder credential — the service identity that selected the winning quote and signed the BidAward. UNLIKE FulfillmentQuoteEnvelope / PaymentRequestEnvelope (where holder == the inner-document signer), this holder is independent of the awarded quote's signer; the award binding is carried by proof.challenge (award_hash), not by holder equality. The settler asserts holder ∈ its configured trusted-awarder list. did:pkh form keeps the authority anchored to a key the proof recovers to; the chain namespace is a convention (e.g. eip155:1) shared with the settler's trust list.

verifiableCredential.description: Array of issuer-signed credentials about the award authority. For MVP this carries exactly the quoteAwarder KnownToAtum credential (issuer did:web:atumlabs.xyz) asserting the holder is authorized to award bids. The verifier's policy decides required types + trusted issuers. minItems 1; maxItems matches the verifier's defaultMaxVerifiableCredentials (an unauthenticated-DoS backstop mirroring the verifier default).

proof.description: Holder-signed W3C Data Integrity proof. proofPurpose MUST be 'authentication'; challenge MUST equal award_hash(payment_id, quote_hash, settler_id) — the content-addressed identifier binding this envelope to a specific award decision, recomputed by the settler; domain MUST equal the verifier's configured NETWORK-WIDE service identifier `did:web:<env>.atum.network`. Distinct challenge value-space (award_hash) + the BidAwardEnvelope declaration-type binding keep a captured envelope from being replayed as / against an FQE or PRE verifier.

VPDataIntegrityProof.description: W3C Data Integrity proof for a VerifiablePresentation. Extends the base DataIntegrityProof with challenge and domain per W3C VC Data Model 5.6. proofPurpose is constrained to 'authentication': the holder is authenticating themselves as the presenter of the enclosed credentials.

type.description: Proof type identifier. MUST be one of EcdsaSecp256k1RecoverySignature2020 (secp256k1) or Ed25519Signature2020 (ed25519), and MUST equal the inner declaration's proof.type so the holder-binding consistency check anchors both signatures to the same cryptosuite.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the proof was created. Canonicalize the value exactly as it appears in the raw JSON: parsing it into a date-time and re-serializing can change the spelling (Z versus +00:00), and a different spelling canonicalizes to different bytes, so the signature no longer verifies. The verifier also checks freshness against its configured maximum proof age and future-skew window.

verificationMethod.description: DID URL identifying the verification method, e.g., 'did:pkh:eip155:1:0x...#blockchainAccountId' for ECDSA or 'did:pkh:solana:<chain>:<addr>#SolanaMethod2021' for Ed25519 on Solana, or 'did:pkh:stellar:<network>:<G-account>#blockchainAccountId' for Ed25519 on Stellar. The recovered identity from this MUST match the holder field.

proofPurpose.description: Always 'authentication' for VerifiablePresentation proofs per W3C VC Data Model §5.6 — the holder is authenticating themselves as the presenter of the enclosed credentials.

challenge.description: Replay-binding challenge. MUST equal award_hash(payment_id, quote_hash, settler_id) — the content-addressed award-decision identifier, recomputed by the settler from the award it received. The same authority key signing a different payment, quote, or settler yields a different award_hash, so a captured envelope cannot be replayed across awards.

domain.description: Replay-binding domain. MUST equal the verifier's configured NETWORK-WIDE service identifier `did:web:<env>.atum.network` (e.g., did:web:devnet.atum.network). Distinct from FQE's settler-specific domain so a captured envelope can't be misrouted to FQE-shaped verifiers; without it, a staging envelope could be replayed against production.

jws.description: Detached JWS signature in <base64url(header)>..<base64url(sig)> form, header {alg:ES256K-R, b64:false, crit:[b64]}. Used by the EcdsaSecp256k1RecoverySignature2020 cryptosuite. Exactly one of jws / proofValue must be present, matching the cryptosuite.

proofValue.description: Multibase z-base58btc-encoded 64-byte signature. Used by the Ed25519Signature2020 cryptosuite. Exactly one of jws / proofValue must be present, matching the cryptosuite.

VerifiableCredential.description: W3C Verifiable Credential structure conforming to the W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model v1.1

issuer.description: DID or issuer object of the credential issuer

credentialSubject.description: Claims about the credential subject (structure varies by issuer)

credentialStatus.description: Information for credential revocation checking. Not consulted by the verifier today.
